title: Does joint GGT–ALT structure improve inflammatory-state prediction? An inconclusive transport test beyond flexible liver and metabolic measures
abstract: Joint logGGT–logALT structure did not establish incremental logCRP prediction beyond flexible standard measures in exploratory NHANES2009–2010 to2015–2016 transport (5,006 source;4,486 target adults): weighted MSE difference -0.00011694, joint survey-PSU bootstrap95% interval [-0.00151900,0.00336514] in squared natural-log units.
